segments.text: let me show you a neat little trick that you can use in the data analysis feature in business Central you probably already know that you can filter your Fields here in the analysis filter

menu but did you know that you can also filter your totals just like in normal reports in business Central this is how that is done let's this is a account receivables report you can see my customers down here and I have some remaining different sums

of remaining amounts and I would like to filter away any rows or data here where the amount is greater where the I want to remove all the zero amounts so what I do here is simply on the on this aggregated or totaled um column
I can filter here and I can say greater than zero there you go and voila now you have filtered on totals you can then save this as part of your data analysis definition
